experiment: seat-watcher: would a time-first gate have caught 2026-11-01's problems earlier and with fewer false alarms?

labels.definition: one episode per director intervention: onset, the director's first action (t_help, the point to beat), and the last action

detail.what: mcode Token Plan quota exhausted again; 9 seats had burned it in ~75 min
hung zcode seats killed: ecology-device, night-v3 (ProArt), coldshelf-bakeoff (Thor, ETIMEDOUT since 01:28)
two fetch_bf16 copies of the Seed-OSS BF16 download ran at once (the seat's orphan plus the director's own); the orphan was stopped and the download corrupted from the 02:30-03:30 overlap
an orphaned syzygy gt_batch.sh held heavy.lock for 5.4 h and starved the night-v3 run B; a second job (ecology-device rerun-extra.sh) queued behind it
thor-admit's 2 GiB lfb floor blocked queued leases while ~100 GB of system memory was free; the director restarted the daemon with --gpu-floor 0

the admission FIFO held 8 small requests behind one 58 GB serve.glide lease that had reserved 40 GB and used 85 MB (head-of-line blocking on the construct-bind lock); round 11 (backfill, serve coalescing, shrinking reservations) was queued and went live at 12:15
mcode Token Plan quota exhausted again with 6 seats running; next reset capped at 4
the z.ai weekly limit (error 1310) emptied the last-mile zcode session
lab-motion's MJX/JAX run preallocated the Thor's unified memory; the box hung, needed a power cycle, and the director's kill was blocked by the safety classifier
pi seats thor-admit, coldshelf and syzygy stalled while the Thor was hung; moved back to mcode
one seat's parallel downloads (scenebloom: checkpoints + torch wheels, 6 MB/s) saturated the Thor's weak Wi-Fi (-78 dBm) and every other seat's API calls timed out
mcode quota hit again (3rd time today); coldshelf, scenebloom and thor-admit r13 moved to pi desks

the Thor's disk fell to 27 GB; the external drive was remounted rw at /mnt/toshiba, thor-bench (18 GB) was archived there, scenebloom was told to move its 42 GB of downloads, and a hardlink dedupe of 53 venvs freed 77 GB

matching.time_only: any speak-now event within +/-10 min of the help point
matching.kind_aware: only a speak-now event whose condition could speak about that kind of problem (labels.SIGNALS), within +/-10 min
matching.episode: kind-aware, with the window running from the problem's onset to the director's action - the rule that answers 'would it have caught this earlier?'

a_live.label: level gate restricted to seats that are still alive (a')
